title: Act As a Real Researcher: A Suite of Benchmarks Evaluating Frontier LLMs and Agentic Harnesses in Research Lifecycle
reasoning: The paper conceptualizes and evaluates 'research ethics' and 'integrity' as core researcher qualities. It includes specific benchmark tasks (such as 'False-Guidance-Rebuttal' and 'P-Hacking-Multitest') designed to measure whether LLM agents will refuse instructions to engage in research misconduct and data fabrication.
